name: Jellyfin Cinema Loader
description: Loads the external Jellyfin Cinema Project script into Jellyfin Web automatically. The actual script itself is not bundled -- it is fetched live from GitHub on every page load, so updates to the script never require reinstalling this plugin.
overview: Automatic loader for the Jellyfin Cinema Project userscript.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Injects the Cinema Project script tag into Jellyfin Web via File Transformation (preferred) or direct index.html patching (fallback).
